rule: Consumer key of a two-key promotion. A sport's `promoted` model is served ONLY for games whose newest pregame artifact block also declares itself activated as the operating forecast with exactly this model_version (producer key: NBA_PAG_OPERATING=1 / CFB_OAE_OPERATING=1). Anything else is served from the incumbent and flagged. `promoted: null` = incumbent only. Changing an entry is an owner-approved, reviewed change; reverting it is the rollback.

CFB.incumbent: none: CFB production publishes no model projections (feed status unavailable)
